title: soc2-evidence-daily-scratchpad
content:
Quick daily scratchpad for SOC2 evidence work and vendor reviews. Informal notes, triage, and small TODOs. Mostly notes to self - not for distribution yet.

---

Yesterday:
- met w/ Priya to go over ingestion logs evidence (picked up missing syslog export for app-prod). Action: open ticket to add 72h retention export (JIRA: SOC2-124).
- vendor questionnaire: got answers from S3BackupCo but they didn't provide the encryption-at-rest cert. Follow-up note sent.
- updated confluence table with latest evidence files (see Evidence Index link above).

Today priorities (high -> low):
1) Evidence upload: finish POC export for app-prod logs and upload to evidence bucket. Must include sample hashes and timestamped manifest. (Target: EOD)
2) Vendor follow-ups: chase S3BackupCo for encryption cert + contact at vendor (Anjali). If not received by Tue, escalate to procurement.
3) Policy TODOs: review and edit remote-access policy draft (section 2.3 on key rotation intervals) - leave comments in Confluence.
4) Work with Noah on control test for change management: decide sample window and scope.

Quick checklist for Evidence Upload:
- [ ] Export syslog (72h) from app-prod -> evidence-bucket/test-20250216
- [ ] Generate SHA256 manifest for exported files
- [ ] Attach manifest + short README to confluence evidence page (link above)
- [ ] Note retention rule and link to infra ticket

Vendor review notes (S3BackupCo):
- Questionnaire received 2025-02-13 (see attached PDF on Confluence).
- Missing: encryption-at-rest compliance doc, SOC2 (vendor) attestation date, subcontractor list.
- Risk level: medium until attestation docs received. Suggested mitigation: require client-side encryption for backups until vendor attestation validated.
- Next step: email Anjali (cc procurement) with deadline 2025-02-20. If no response, escalate.

Policy TODOs / Edits:
- Remote access policy (draft v0.4): lower key-rotation interval from 365 -> 180 days for admin keys. Add explicit MFA requirement for console admin accounts. 
- Data retention policy: confirm archival timeline for logs used as evidence (current doc ambiguous between 90 and 365 days). Open PR with suggested text and link to infra ticket.

Open tickets to track (my shorthand):
- SOC2-124: syslog export config (PR opened by infra, needs review)
- SOC2-131: evidence manifest format standard (create template)
- PROC-58: vendor attestation follow-up (procurement owning)

Notes to self / reminders:
- When uploading evidence, include who pulled the export + command used (so auditors can reproduce).
- Keep filenames consistent: evidence_<control>-<yyyyMMdd>-<owner>.tar.gz
- Ask Priya to help QA the manifest tomorrow morning (10:30am sync).

Meeting notes (sync 2025-02-16, 09:00):
- Priya: infra will enable temporary export role for me to pull logs. She will add SRE as reviewer on the infra PR.
- Noah: change mgmt sampling window - recommended last 30 changes, prioritize prod. Noah will draft test plan by Wed.
- Action owners: Tessa (evidence upload), Priya (infra PR), Noah (control test plan), Procurement (vendor escalation).

Misc quick references:
- Evidence index: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SOC2/SOC2+Evidence+Index
- JIRA board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/boards/42
- Slack: #security-compliance thread "vendor-attestation"

Questions / open items:
- Do we already store the export checksums in a long-term immutable store? If not, ask SRE for recommendations.
- Confirm backup vendor subcontractors list - is it included in the vendor questionnaire or separate doc?

End of scratchpad (will clean up and move key items to Confluence / JIRA as tasks).
